display_name: LoRa W24 恢复器与 PAMF 联合训练（Full）
description: Isolate label-CE recovery, reader fine-tuning and joint PAMF training on matched lawful source batches; U_s never supplies labels.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: User-authorized E104 guidance and trainable PAMF on legal L_s. Unlabeled U_s has no label or reader loss. Source V truth-last; only immutable E104 can enter the original conditional Full target acceptance.

checkpoint.initialization: All rows strictly load the source-frozen E104 and fixed 24000-step original-loss U-Net, same data contract, reset optimizer. The auxiliary clean anchor is an unchanged copy of E104.

sources.role: Original E104 PAMF and fixed clean anchor; remains fixed in G-only CE row.
Fixed-step original loss U-Net common initialization.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: User explicitly authorized G and PAMF joint optimization. No U label, U classifier forward, source V, target observations/truth, or practical/trace during fit.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze all three rows at step 6000. Source V Full 300×7 and independent truth-last. Only frozen_pamf_ce enters official Full if six strictly exceeds direct, DURA outer and U-Net parent, low urban matches all three, and clean matches direct. Joint/PAMF-only source evidence reported separately.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 GPU preference 3,0,7,2,6,5; up to three separate GPUs with >=12 GiB free and fewer than eight visible contexts; at most one new worker per GPU, no modification of other jobs.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on protocol/frozen proof error, nonfinite loss, inactive expected CE gradient, missing source matrix, or mismatch of fixed baselines. Preserve outputs and other workers.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: New module score-source followed by separately invoked joint module collect for only the immutable E104 formal candidate after three frozen shards.

rows.method: Frozen G, tune PAMF and default classification head
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, G lr 8e-5, F lr 3e-5 for enabled groups, cosine eta_min 2e-6, grad clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: Fixed 6000 additional AdamW updates after shared E104 and 24000-step G prior. Both source roles independently sampled each update; exactly 96000 exposures per role.

notes: Explicit user-authorized joint training. L_s supplies 16 truth labels per step, independently sampled from 2800 lawful L_s; U_s supplies 16 blind IQ packets per step from 25200 and never enters either CE or any teacher classifier loss.

Joint optimization uses restored L_s CE (1.0), average raw and restored clean L_s CE (.65), L_s clean posterior anchor KL to original E104 (.30), both roles paired waveform spectral (.30) and complex MSE (.25), true clean L_s G identity (1.50). Train PAMF in evaluation forwarding mode with selected parameters requiring gradients to align normalization and dropout to deployment. All learnable parameters include original default head, no detached head.

All arms use identical source IQ stream, independent generic disturbance, fixed initialization and AdamW schedule. Readout is the established differentiable half update onto only the 384 center points; raw 48 edges are copied. Exact E104 inference unchanged in fixed-reader arm and original official thresholds.

Independent source truth-last gives direct E104, outer DURA and original U-Net history, PAMF-only, CE-G with fixed E104, joint, joint G with original E104 and joint PAMF with old G. Only the fixed-E104 route may promote to official 30,000-packet Full; joint-updated PAMF is separately reported.
